name: PostgreSQL
description: Import any standard PostgreSQL database: pg_catalog-native inspection with exact type preservation, read-only session enforced, batched keyset extraction with deterministic resume. Real log-based CDC via WAL logical decoding (pgoutput): INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE capture with durable LSN checkpoints (35.6). No silent source mutation.
author: TEMM Nexus (first-party)

ui.setup_instructions: Provide host, port, database, username and password. Use a least-privilege READ-ONLY role (CONNECT + SELECT on the schemas to import); the connector additionally enforces read-only sessions. Unknown extension types are flagged NEEDS_REVIEW rather than silently approximated.
